record.field:
Soak
Solution 49 wt% HF
Tool: AS-01
Balance DI water - 18 Mohm-cm
Duration: 3 minutes, 30 seconds
Use automated spray tool to clean and rinse parts:
1. Verify exhaust and CDA systems are on, exhaust >0.25 inch WC, CDA=95 psi
2. Verify HF reservoir is filled to red MIN line
3. If HF is below MIN line: actuate drain valve, open lid, add HF to line, close lid, deactuate drain valve
4. Pre-rinse tank: actuate tank rinse - 1 min, part rinse - 1 min
5. Open lid, verify pH>5. If pH<5. Neutralize, drain and replace DI, repeat tank pre-rinse
6. Load quartz liner, load showerhead with small holes up, close lid
7. Pre-rinse parts: part rinse - 1 min, tank rinse - 1 min
8. N2 purge - 30 sec
9. Open lid, tip showerhead to drain, close lid, drain 1 min
10. Insure lid completely closed
11. Actuate drain valve, acid spray, acid pump - 3 min, 30 seconds
12. Acid pump off, wait 5 seconds, acid spray off
13. N2 purge part spray until liquid stops or 30 seconds
14. Let drain 30 seconds, then deactuate drain valve
15. Rinse parts: part rinse - 1 min, tank rinse - 1 min, part rinse - 5 min, tank rinse - 5 min
16. N2 purge part spray - 1 min, N2 purge tank - 1 min
17. N2 purge part until parts stop dripping
18. Open lid
19. Transfer parts to second rinse bath - do not allow parts to sit in tool

Use automated spray tool to clean and rinse parts:
1. Verify exhaust and CDA systems are on, exhaust >0.25 inch WC, CDA=95 psi
2. Verify HF reservoir is filled to red MIN line
3. If HF is below MIN line: actuate drain valve, open lid, add HF to line, close lid, deactuate drain valve
4. Pre-rinse tank: actuate tank rinse - 1 min, part rinse - 1 min
5. Open lid, verify pH>5. If pH<5. Neutralize, drain and replace DI, repeat tank pre-rinse
6. Load quartz liner, load showerhead with small holes up, close lid
7. Pre-rinse parts: part rinse - 1 min, tank rinse - 1 min
8. N2 purge - 30 sec
9. Open lid, tip showerhead to drain, close lid, drain 1 min
10. Insure lid completely closed
11. Actuate drain valve, acid spray, acid pump - 3 min, 30 seconds
12. Acid pump off, wait 5 seconds, acid spray off
13. N2 purge part spray until liquid stops or 30 seconds

19. Transfer parts to second rinse bath - do not allow parts to sit in tool
